name: Every Time I Think of You

podcast.body: Released in January 1979 in the US, this song reached number 13 on the Billboard Hot 100 and was a Top 10 hit in both Canada and Australia, demonstrating its global popularity. John Waite was on lead vocals for the track. "It made its number 13 on the Billboard Hot 100. It was Top 10 in Canada. It was Top 10 in Australia."
